dct_title_s: Jamaica, particulars and conditions of sale of a valuable Sugar Estate : known as Savoy, with a run of land called Orange River Pen, in the Parish of Clarendon, in the Island of Jamaica, containing together 765 acres, or thereabouts, together with the fixtures, machinery, and live and dead stock thereon : which will be sold by auction in two lots, by Messrs. Hards, Vaughan & Jenkinson, before James Fleming, Esq., Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esq., Commissioners for Sale of Incumbered Estates in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
